plugins.description: Per-branch handoff notes for Claude Code — auto-load the non-code knowledge the diff can't show into fresh sessions on the same branch.

skills.name: handoff
skills.description: Write or refresh the current git branch's handoff note — the non-code knowledge (goal, decisions and their rationale, gotchas found while implementing, what's done, what's still open, where the key code lives, how to verify) that a fresh agent on this branch should start with. Invoke when finishing a chunk of work on a branch, at the end of implementing a plan, or whenever the user types /handoff. Optionally takes free-text instructions to steer this note (what to focus on, include, or omit), or a subcommand — `workstream …` to set up/manage a multi-repo workstream, or `prune` to clean up orphan notes/workstreams. The note is auto-loaded into future sessions on the same branch by the branch-handoff SessionStart hook.
skills.description_zh: 为当前Git分支编写或更新交接笔记，记录目标、决策理由、实施陷阱、完成与待办、关键代码及验证方式，供新代理接续；支持工作段结束、/handoff、跨仓库workstream或prune清理，后续同分支由钩子自动加载。
